# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P43](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0043)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c34 P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Roy Gardner is a tall, broad-shouldered, and remarkably handsome young man with dark, wavy hair and a fine, clean-shaven chin. He has large, brilliant, dark-gray eyes with long black lashes that give him a striking, romantic, and somewhat melancholy look. He possesses a charming, melodious voice, a courteous demeanor, and dresses with exceptional taste and style.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P43](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0043), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c36 P12](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0012), [v1 c37 P29](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0029), [v3 c23 P27](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0027), [v3 c23 P28](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0028), [v3 c25 P29](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0029)_

## Personality

Roy is an ardent, poetic, and deeply romantic individual who Woos with polished, elegant compliments and courtly gestures. He is earnest and sincere in his devotions, though he lacks a strong sense of humor, often taking jokes or playful situations too seriously. Though refined, intellectual, and unfailingly polite, his conversation can at times lean toward the poetic rather than the practical.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v1 c33 P38](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0038), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c37 P27](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0027), [v3 c25 P15](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0015), [v3 c27 P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

## History

Roy Gardner originally attended Redmond College for his Freshman and Sophomore years before taking two years off to travel in Europe with his mother. Upon his return to complete his Arts degree, he met Anne Shirley in the park on a rainy afternoon when her umbrella turned inside out and he offered his shelter. Deeply taken with her, he began courting her attentively, sending her elegant bouquets of flowers and writing sonnets in her honor. Throughout their Junior and Senior years at Redmond, he remained her devoted escort at college functions, leading many to assume an engagement was inevitable. However, after his proposal to Anne in the park pavilion following their graduation, she realized she did not truly love him in return and rejected his offer. Devastated, Roy bade her farewell and parted from her life.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P36](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0036), [v1 c25 P38](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0038), [v1 c25 P44](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0044), [v1 c33 P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 c36 P12](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0012), [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 c38 P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P21](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0021), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)_

## Quotes

> Pardon me—may I offer you the shelter of my umbrella?  <sub>[v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028)</sub>

> We are classmates as well as collegemates. I am reconciled to the loss of the years that the locust has eaten.  <sub>[v1 c25 P40](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0040)</sub>

> I have a dream. I persist in dreaming it, although it has often seemed to me that it could never come true. I dream of a home with a hearth-fire in it, a cat and dog, the footsteps of friends—and you!  <sub>[v3 c20 P22](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0022)</sub>

> I asked you a question over two years ago, Anne. If I ask it again today will you give me a different answer?  <sub>[v3 c20 P24](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0024)</sub>

> You have ruined my life.  <sub>[v3 c38 P27](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0027)</sub>
